fact: Direct social aid has been paid since end December 2023, with government and central bank requiring payment only into payment or bank accounts, not cash (Médias24).

Between 2023 and 2025 Morocco's National Social Support Agency disbursed 51 billion dirhams of direct social assistance to nearly four million families, deposited monthly into payment accounts (TelQuel).
system: Direct social assistance via payment accounts

fact: The government's written answer says Direct Social Support eligibility rests on household scoring in the Unified Social Register, with monthly electronic data exchanges used to verify ongoing eligibility.
The World Bank G2Px blog reports that recipients of Morocco's DAAM program valued receiving payments into an account, enabling ATM withdrawals 24 hours a day with no waiting.
